computer_use_provisioning.problem: The setup profile template cannot run computer_use: at boot Hermes PM activates the profile's committed PM environment (pm.environments.activate_dependencies), which was built without the computer-use extra, and the venv's site-packages are removed from sys.path. The first computer_use call then lazily runs 'uv sync' with the extra, which the dead egress proxy refuses ('computer_use backend unavailable: venv: uv sync exited 1'). pilot-05/06 failed this way. The setup never ran a GUI turn, so it did not see this.
computer_use_provisioning.fix_lane_local: A private copy of the template home, overlaid at the template's own absolute path (so PM's absolute paths stay valid). PM's own ensure_import('computer-use') ran once in that copy. An offline attempt seeded from the existing uv cache failed: PM's uv 0.12.3 did not reuse the 0.11.7 cache entries. The successful run used network for that single step, with 'uv sync --locked' verifying every wheel hash against uv.lock. The shared setup template was not changed.
